campaign.title: Return and estimate the recombined R1 arithmetic residue

conductor_policy.monitoring: Work only on Rar[R1]. Retain admissible contour lines, conditional L-series convergence, the physical top limit, y=0/1/N seams, all floors, and the external X^(1/4) factor.
conductor_policy.round_close: Close after a statement-only exact return, an analytic fixed-y BV proof, a hostile contour/normalization audit, and graph adjudication.

resource_policy.literature_policy: No source import is needed for the proposed elementary mechanism; search only if an exact analytic seam fails.

frozen_target.candidate_bound: Derive the exact physical y-integral and prove its fixed-y q-sum is O(D_j/sqrt(Xy)); integrate from the automatic threshold y>>D_j^2/X and sum D_j geometrically to obtain normalized O(1).
frozen_target.success: A complete normalized O(polylog X), preferably O(1), residue bound, or an exact counterexample to the return/BV transfer.

campaign.promotion_policy: Promote only after independent agreement on the exact sign and powers, legitimate limit order, q-character placement, small-y threshold, sampled variation, and physical normalization.
